trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing special to do for it beyond finishing everything else. It is the last trophy by design: work the roadmap in order and it arrives with the final cleanup trophy. No online play, DLC or second playthrough is needed for it. Keep cheats off the save you use for the platinum: using one disables trophies and saving, and the block lasts for the current session.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one unlocks automatically with the last of them.
Use the S1–S7 roadmap and the Next up panel to see what is left, cheapest first.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening story mission, Gone Fishing, is the first mission of Chapter 1 and cannot be missed: play through it and the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is the earliest story trophy in the list, so it should be one of the first two you earn.
steps: Start Chapter 1 and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes; no side objective is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops with the chapter's close. Chapter 1 is also where the one possibly missable trophy begins, so meditate at Jason's house when the game offers it, and answer Cal's fishing text when it arrives, before moving on.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions in order.
Before the chapter ends, meditate at Jason's house and take Cal's fishing challenge, so the missable watch items are safe.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes. Chapter 2 is where the map opens up properly: Moses hands over the Scooter Bros app, Billy's jobs open at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, and Bret's hunting quests begin, so pick those threads up as they appear.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions in order.
Take the Scooter Bros app from Moses and start Billy's and Bret's quest lines when they open.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops with the chapter. Chapter 3 takes the story into Vice City itself, and Yasmani's jobs in this chapter hand over the Snap Gun used to slip into a jewelry store unseen, which is worth remembering for the Sneakthief trophy later.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions in order.
Do Yasmani's jobs when offered; the Snap Gun they provide matters for a later robbery trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes. An optional mission in this chapter opens the bank vault robberies, so take it when it appears: five vaults have to be robbed and escaped from for the Maximum Withdrawal trophy, and they all bring a four-star wanted level.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions in order.
Take the optional mission that opens bank vaults, then rob vaults when you are ready for a four-star escape.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission and this gold trophy pops with the credits. It is one of only two gold trophies in the list, the other being the 100% completion trophy. After the credits the game returns you to free roam, the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress, Stats, and everything left on the list is still reachable.
steps: Play through Chapter 5 to the final mission and complete it.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the post-story checklist.
Check the checklist the moment it opens; progress you made during the story already counts toward it.
Keep playing in free roam; nothing on the list is locked out by finishing the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops with the mission complete screen. Like all story mission trophies, it cannot be missed: the mission stays available until you finish it.
steps: Reach Chapter 2 and take the Breakfast Run mission when it appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission, one of the bigger set-piece jobs in the middle of the game. Finish it and the trophy pops. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed, and there is no extra objective beyond completing the mission itself.
steps: Reach Chapter 3 and take The Cartel Heist when it appears.
Play the heist through to its end; the trophy pops on completion.
Park a fast getaway car nearby before the heist starts, so the escape is already planned.
Stock up on armour and ammo beforehand, as with any big story job.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission. Complete it and the trophy pops. Story mission trophies never need anything beyond finishing the mission, and this one stays available until you do.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and take the Child's Play mission when it appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission. Play it through and the trophy pops when it ends. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed and needs no side objective.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and take the Headliners mission when it appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission set around the airport. Finish it and the trophy pops. Getting comfortable around VCIA in this mission also helps later, when a different trophy asks for an unscheduled departure from the same airport.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and take the VCIA Takedown mission when it appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
Note the airport layout while you are there; it comes back for a later trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission, late in the game. Complete it and the trophy pops. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed; by this point the final mission is close, so finish the chapter and the story's gold trophy follows.
steps: Reach Chapter 5 and take Operation Savage Glory when it appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story ends — though progress made during the story already counts toward it. The checklist is more forgiving than it sounds: it asks for roughly 60% true completion, with 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 50 of 66 weapons, while robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be finished in full. It is the hardest trophy in the list and the second gold, so expect most of the roughly 200-hour platinum to be spent here.
steps: Finish the story; the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in order, starting with the full-completion rows: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
For the partial rows, aim for 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 50 of 66 weapons.
Skip the ten hardest challenges; the checklist lets you.
Scan vehicles and study animals through binoculars while travelling, so the counts grow during normal play.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across the whole game: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 stunts in total to choose from. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past this trophy rather than stopping at 250. Stunts build up naturally if you drive fast and take jumps whenever you see them.
steps: Attempt stunts whenever you travel: ramps, jumps, bridge flights and base jumps all count.
Track the running total in the checklist; any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game will do.
Keep stunting past 250: the 100% checklist needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's activity types once: fishing, racing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races, hunting, meditation and the rest. You do not need to win or finish anything, just sample one of each. Most of these unlock naturally in the first chapters, so a single lap around the activities menu in Chapter 1 and 2 covers most of the list.
steps: Open the activities list and note which types you have not tried yet.
Try one of each type once: a race, a fishing spot, a shooting range, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race and the rest.
Winning is not required; taking part once is enough for each type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Every range must be finished in full for the 100% checklist too, so this is not a trophy to leave until the end: visit each range as you find it and gold its challenges while your aim is warm. The gold times and scores are demanding but fair, and the guides agree they are not the hardest medals in the game.
steps: Find the shooting ranges as you explore; there are 12 in total.
Gold every challenge at each range: 42 gold medals in all.
Warm up at one range first, then work through the rest in order.
Retry a challenge at once if you miss gold; your best result stands.
All 42 are also required for 100% completion, so finishing them here pays twice.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. There are 42 races in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them won, so treat this trophy as the first 14 wins of a 42-win job. Drone handling rewards smooth lines over raw speed: learn each course's corners before pushing for the win.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races; there are 14 locations.
Win one race at each location to pop this trophy.
Keep winning: the 100% checklist needs all 42 races won.
Upgrade the drone's handling before racing for wins, if the option is available.
Fly a practice lap first to learn the course, then race for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 in the game. Winning the same race twice does not count, so spread your wins across new events. Road, off-road and water races all count toward the 20, and a faster car or boat for the event type matters more than perfect driving.
steps: Enter races across the map; there are 40 different ones.
Win 20 different races; a repeat win of the same race adds nothing.
Match your vehicle to the race type before you start.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon, so watch your phone early in the game and do not ignore the message. Fishing is a timing game: hook the fish, then keep the line tension in the safe zone until it tires.
steps: Play Chapter 1 until Cal texts you and a purple icon marks the fishing spot.
Go to the marked spot and start the fishing challenge against Cal.
Beat his catch to pop the trophy; keep line tension steady and let the fish tire.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game to completion. Arcades are scattered around Leonida and the games inside them are short, so this is a quick trophy once you find a machine. Pick the game you find easiest and play it through to its end screen.
steps: Find an arcade machine in Leonida.
Start any arcade game and play it through to completion.
The trophy pops when the game ends; the score does not matter.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Andy is one of the side characters whose strands stay open after the story, so there is no rush, but note that his strand does not count toward the eight Strangers & Freaks strands — that trophy only counts Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among the named strangers.
steps: Find Andy's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.
The strand stays open after the story, so finish it in cleanup if needed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand and complete his final mission. Kenton is a side character, and his strand stays open after the story ends, so this is a cleanup trophy: do it once the main story is done and the map is fully open.
steps: Find Kenton's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.
The strand stays open after the story, so finish it in cleanup if needed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand and complete his final mission. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story, so you can start them in Chapter 2 and finish them whenever suits you. Like the other side-character finals, Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission that opens it, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through Billy's five jobs in order.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy; the jobs stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some stranger strands count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not, because those characters have their own trophies or strands. That makes the counting strands the ones to prioritise; you can finish them after the story, and the cleanup phase of the roadmap is built around them.
steps: Find stranger missions across Leonida, marked when strangers need help.
Prioritise the counting strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Do not rely on Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy or Billy for this count; they have their own trophies.
Check each stranger's strand progress before moving on, so you know which of the eight are done.
Complete eight counting strands in full to pop the trophy.
Strands can be finished after the story, in the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Randy is a side character whose strand stays open after the story, so this is a cleanup trophy: work through his jobs once the story is done and the whole map is open.
steps: Find Randy's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.
The strand stays open after the story, so finish it in cleanup if needed.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand and complete his final mission. Tyrone is a side character whose strand stays open after the story, so this is a cleanup trophy. Note that his strand does not count toward the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.
steps: Find Tyrone's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.
The strand stays open after the story, so finish it in cleanup if needed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia. This is the list's only possibly missable trophy: the first spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable once that chapter ends, and nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs that exact spot — so meditate the moment the Chapter 1 prompt appears. Two safety nets soften the risk: the last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which only opens after Chapter 2, and the 100% checklist asks for just 15 of the 18 spots, so even a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you the 100% trophy. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 as well, in case you need to go back.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house the moment the game offers it; that spot may not come back.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1, before the meditation prompt, as a safety net.
Visit the remaining spots across Leonida's 10 meditation locations, with both Jason and Lucia.
At shared spots, meditate with both Jason and Lucia so each character's count grows.
The final spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2.
Meditate at all 18 spots; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only, and Bret's quests must be finished in full for the 100% checklist, so start them early and work through them as they come. The exact animal for this trophy has not been confirmed yet in the guides, so follow Bret's quest markers rather than guessing a species, and check the quest text when each hunt opens.
steps: After Chapter 2, start Bret's hunting quests as Jason.
Follow each hunt's markers and quest text to the target animal.
Complete the hunt for the unique animal Bret asks for.
Finish all of Bret's quests: the 100% checklist needs every one of them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 sets in the game. Cards are hidden around Leonida, so pick the three sets whose cards cluster nearest each other and sweep those areas in one run. You only need three sets for the trophy, even though the game holds eighteen.
steps: Find collectible cards around Leonida; there are 18 sets in total.
Pick three sets and collect every card in each of them.
Check the card album to see which cards each set is still missing.
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations, in any mix of the four tag types: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. It is a scanning habit more than a hunt: open WAiNK It whenever you pass somewhere notable and the count climbs during normal travel. Start in Chapter 1 so the total is already high by the time you reach cleanup.
steps: Open WAiNK It at notable spots: Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher tags all count.
Scan whenever you pass somewhere new, starting in Chapter 1.
Check the WAiNK map for tags you have not scanned yet, and sweep them area by area.
Reach 100 scanned locations in any mix of the four types.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger number: pick the easy challenges first, skip the hardest ten, and let the count grow as you play. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying and more, so any style of play feeds the total.
steps: Open the challenges list and pick the easiest ones first.
Complete 50 challenges of any kind to pop this trophy.
Keep going: the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, and you may skip the ten hardest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. The easiest escape the guides agree on is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow you along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and the trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then drive for the tunnel.
steps: Play with your partner alongside you and build a four-star wanted level.
Stock up on armour before you build the wanted level, so the escape is not cut short.
Drive to the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
Stay on the tracks until you leave the red heat zone and the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them — keeping the heat is the point, so do not shake the police until the third robbery is done. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well for this, since they sit close together. Plan the route first, then hit all three in one run.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three close shops; the jewelry stores in north Vice City work well.
Rob the first shop, then the second, then the third, back-to-back.
Keep your wanted level alive through all three robberies; the trophy pops after the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them. The 100% checklist asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so this trophy is the halfway mark of a longer scan: point the scanner at every new vehicle you pass from Chapter 1 onward, and the count grows during normal travel. Busy streets and car parks are the fastest places to find models you have not scanned yet.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you pass, starting in Chapter 1.
Sweep car parks and busy streets for models you have not scanned yet.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles to pop this trophy.
Keep scanning: the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. Pick your targets with care: the guides report it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so take on gang members at their illegal operations, where five targets gather in one place.
steps: Buff your focus first: eat, drink or shower at home, and bring Adrenaline.
Go to a gang illegal operation with an assault rifle, where gang members gather.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down five gang members before it ends.
Use cover between kills so the focus meter lasts through all five takedowns.
If it fails, reset and try again; soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off, and get about a kilometre away. The airport is familiar ground by Chapter 5, after the VCIA Takedown mission, so slip in, take the jet and climb away from the runway before security closes in.
steps: Go to VCIA and find a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate.
Board it, take off, and fly about a kilometre clear of the airport.
The trophy pops once you are clear; expect attention on the runway, so move fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The Rhino is the tank in question, and the air station is a guarded military site, so go in ready for a fight: grab the tank, then use its cannon on the enemies that come for you. The trophy is about the theft and the kills together, not just sitting in the driver's seat.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station ready for a fight.
Steal a Rhino tank from the base.
Take out enemies from inside the tank to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs provide the Snap Gun for the back door, which is the quiet way in: use it, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so back out and try again rather than fighting through it.
steps: Do Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs to get the Snap Gun for the back door.
Pick a jewelry store and enter through the back, unseen.
Take the goods and leave without being detected; if spotted, restart the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape from each one, out of the eight vaults in the game. Vaults open with an optional Chapter 4 mission, so take that mission first. Every vault robbery brings a four-star wanted level, so plan the escape before you go in: a fast car parked nearby and a route out of the heat zone turn a hard trophy into a routine one.
steps: Take the optional Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults.
Rob a vault, then escape the four-star wanted level it brings.
Expect a four-star wanted level after every vault; plan the escape before you go in.
Repeat for five vaults in total; there are eight in the game.
Park a fast getaway car nearby and plan the escape route before each robbery.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida, so watch for one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives. A sticky bomb or a hard ram stops the truck; speed matters more than firepower once the money is in hand.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route around Leonida.
Stop the truck and take the cash from it.
Escape the police response to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map, across all 52 areas. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map, since flying over an area reveals it. Work the map in strips, island by island, and check the fog line after each flight to see what is left.
steps: Get a plane and fly the map in strips to clear the fog.
Cover all 52 areas of Leonida, island by island.
Check the map after each flight for fog that is still left, then finish those patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs, one per gang. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them robbed, so this trophy is the first nine of a 39-operation job: hit one operation per gang for the trophy, then keep going for the checklist. Each operation is a defended site, so go in armed and expect a fight on the way out.
steps: Find illegal operations around Leonida; nine gangs run them.
Rob one operation for each of the nine gangs.
Note which gangs you have robbed, so the ninth is not a repeat.
The trophy pops with the ninth gang's operation; keep going, as 100% needs all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger for this trophy has not been confirmed yet in any guide: the description points to a cocktail with a view, so try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach and order a drink where the ocean is in view. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing, and the Sources tab lists it among the five trophies whose triggers the guides have not yet cracked.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a bar with a view of the water.
Order a cocktail there and linger with the view in front of you.
If it does not pop, try other beachfront spots; the trigger is still unconfirmed, so this guide does not invent one.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points to driving out through the showroom window, in the style of the series' classic opening, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed yet in any guide. Try driving a showroom car straight out through the front glass, and if it does not pop, wait for the guides to pin the trigger down rather than chasing a guess. This guide marks it unconfirmed.
steps: Go to a vehicle showroom and get into one of its cars.
Drive out through the showroom's front window.
If it does not pop, the trigger is still unconfirmed; check the Sources tab for updates rather than repeating a guess.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. The trophy's description is a joke about follow-through; the job itself is a gang operation robbery like the others, with the Kingpin Bowling site as the target. Go in armed, take the site, and break away from the police response afterward.
steps: Go to the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn.
Rob the operation.
Lose the police after the robbery to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Working out together trains both characters at once, so take them to the gym as a pair and repeat the strength exercises until both bars are full. It is a slow grind rather than a single event, so fold gym visits into your routine between missions.
steps: Take Jason and Lucia to the gym together; working out as a pair trains both.
Repeat strength exercises until Jason's Strength is maxed.
Alternate gym visits with missions, so the training fits around the story.
Repeat until Lucia's Strength is maxed too; the trophy pops when both are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Take 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Ordinary play fills this count on its own: crimes, choices and side activities all move the profile. One warning from the guides matters more than the grind: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent, so vary your actions and keep an eye on where the profile is heading.
steps: Play normally; crimes, choices and side activities all count toward the 500.
Check your Criminal Profile now and then to see the count climb.
Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: the guides warn it is permanent.
The trophy pops at 500 profile-changing actions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed yet in any guide, so this guide will not invent one. It sits on the unconfirmed list in the Sources tab with the other four trophies whose triggers the guides have not yet cracked, and the honest advice is to play normally and watch for the guides to confirm it.
steps: Play normally; the trigger is still unconfirmed, so no specific attempt is prescribed here.
If a second attempt at a failed event pops it, note the event for other players.
Check the Sources tab for the confirmed trigger once the guides crack it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description hints at witnessing something strange, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed yet in any guide, so this guide will not invent one. It is one of the five trophies on the unconfirmed list: explore odd corners of Leonida, follow strange encounters when they appear, and watch for the guides to confirm the trigger.
steps: Explore unusual places and follow strange encounters when they appear.
The trigger is still unconfirmed, so no specific event is prescribed here.
Check the Sources tab for the confirmed trigger once the guides crack it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by: knock people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, the way a bowling ball clears pins. The exact trigger has not been confirmed yet in any guide, so the count and the target type are still open questions; try melee drive-bys on groups of pedestrians from a slow-moving car and see if it pops, and otherwise wait for the guides to confirm it.
steps: Get a vehicle and try melee attacks on pedestrians from a moving car.
Aim for groups, so one pass can knock several down at once.
The trigger is still unconfirmed; check the Sources tab once the guides pin it down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, not a single haul, so launder what you earn as you go and the number climbs steadily. Yasmani pays the most of the contacts, so favour him when you have the choice. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so this trophy grows alongside the crime trophies.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts; Yasmani pays the most.
Launder in batches as the bills pile up, so the total keeps climbing.
Keep laundering as you earn; the running total needs $250,000.
The trophy pops when the total is reached.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. You will hit this naturally if you buy gear, clothes, weapons and vehicles as you go; there is no need to save up for one big spree. If it is the last money trophy standing, a garage property or a round of weapon upgrades closes the gap fast.
steps: Buy gear, clothes, weapons and vehicles as you play; every shop purchase counts.
The running total needs $100,000 across all shops.
If it is nearly done, close the gap with a garage or weapon upgrades.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties for sale, about $160,000 in total. The four story garages do not count, so only the eight purchasable ones matter. Buy them as money allows during the post-story phase, when laundering and robberies have filled your wallet, and keep free garage space for the vehicles you register to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Find the eight garage properties for sale around Leonida.
Buy all eight; the total is about $160,000.
The four story garages do not count toward this trophy.
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each registration, so keep a slot open before you start. Any ten vehicles will do, so register the ones you drive most and top the list up with cars you find on the street.
steps: Take the Scooter Bros app from Moses in Chapter 2.
Keep free garage space for the registrations.
Register street cars you already like driving, so the ten are vehicles you will actually use.
Register ten vehicles to the app; any ten will do.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
